title: Matter of the Gospel: Christ and application of His merit
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): 2. ye doctrine belonging toward applying Christ's merit—remission belonging toward sins (Acts 10:36, 43), perfect righteousness belonging toward Christ promised toward us (1 Cor. 1:30), and eternal salvation (Rom. 1:16; 1 Tim. 1:15). — Ye Gospel chiefly contains as subject-matter two things: 1. ye doctrine belonging toward Christ ye Savior belonging toward humans and His merit (Rom. 1:3)—incarnation, fulfillment belonging toward ye law, payment belonging toward penalties, liberation from ye curse, reconciliation with God, overthrow belonging toward ye Devil;
pass_b_english: The Gospel chiefly contains as subject-matter two things: 1. the doctrine of Christ the Savior of humans and His merit (Rom. 1:3)—incarnation, fulfillment of the law, payment of penalties, liberation from the curse, reconciliation with God, overthrow of the Devil;
2. the doctrine of applying Christ's merit—remission of sins (Acts 10:36, 43), perfect righteousness of Christ promised to us (1 Cor. 1:30), and eternal salvation (Rom. 1:16; 1 Tim. 1:15).
source_text: Continet autem Euangelium tanquam materiam subiectam potissimum duo: 1. doctrinam de Christo salvatore hominum eiusque merito (Rom. 1:3)—ubi dogmata de incarnatione, impletione legis, solutione poenarum, liberatione a maledictione, reconciliatione cum Deo, superatione Diaboli; 2. doctrinam de applicatione meriti Christi, ubi agitur de remissione peccatorum (Acts 10:36, 43), de perfecta iustitia Christi nobis promissa (1 Cor. 1:30), de salute aeterna (Rom. 1:16; 1 Tim. 1:15).
